title: Chandler Jaycees BMX is tied to the current Chandler track site
status: B2 SPECIALIST RETROSPECTIVE + B1 PERIOD + A1 CURRENT CROSS-CHECK
summary: A BMX history timeline says Chandler Jaycees began in 1975 and remained in the same location; period BMX Plus! identifies Chandler Jaycees as the ABA’s first track, while current USA BMX places today’s Chandler BMX at Frye and McQueen and describes it as the first track the ABA opened for sanctioned racing. Same physical site is supported; exact historical course geometry remains open.

title: Chandler becomes an ABA institutional anchor
summary: USA BMX says Chandler BMX at McQueen and Frye was the first BMX track the ABA opened in 1977 for sanctioned BMX events.

title: Public photo caption remembers Randolph Park BMX Track
summary: A public photo caption identifies “Randolph Park BMX Track, Tucson AZ” in 1977. The Atlas preserves the statement as personal truth rather than converting it into an independently verified exact race date or course footprint.

title: Winter Nationals at Chandler Jaycees BMX
summary: A period BMX Plus! report places the early ABA Winter Nationals at Chandler Jaycees BMX through roughly 1979–1983.

title: A rider later recalls BMX racing at Reid Park and Manzanita
summary: A 2009 first-person post by a former Tucson resident who said he lived there from 1980 to 1983 recalls racing BMX at Reid Park and Manzanita. The recollection is preserved as attributed memory, not normalized into exact event dates.

title: Debbi Kalsow records Arizona No.1 girls titles
summary: Debbi Kalsow's official Hall of Fame profile records her as ABA AZ-01 Girls No.1 in both 1981 and 1982.

title: A rider later recalls Peoria Dunes’ first-night racing
summary: In a 2015 memorial comment, Ken Barrier recalled racing Peoria Dunes’ first night in 1982 and being invited to join Ted Jorgensen’s team. The account is not converted into a precise opening date or independent ownership claim.

title: Tri Valley and Window Rock appear in an early period directory
summary: The premiere issue of Bikes & Dirt lists Tri Valley in Casa Grande and Window Rock BMX, pushing both governed identities back to September 1982.

title: Patterson brothers teach at Mile-Hi BMX Summer Camp
summary: BMX Plus! says Brent and Brian Patterson taught BMX skills at the Mile-Hi BMX Summer Camp in Prescott in 1983, strengthening the period activity witness while leaving the exact camp footprint open.

title: Period directory reveals nine additional Arizona BMX identities
summary: Bikes & Dirt lists Tri Valley, Reid Park, Hillside, Chino Valley, Mile-Hi, Bullhead City Kiwanis, Window Rock, White Mountain BMX Raceway and Peoria Dunes in Arizona.

title: Roadrunner Raceway repeats under Phoenix
summary: Bikes & Dirt lists Roadrunner Raceway under Phoenix in March 1984, and BMX Action repeats the exact track name under Phoenix in May 1985. The exact site, operator role and relationship to similarly named Road Runner records remain open.

title: Period directory lists Manzanita Park BMX in Tucson
summary: Bikes & Dirt lists Tucson, Manzanita Park BMX with Louie Stockmeyer as contact.

title: Road Runner BMX becomes Black Mountain
summary: USA BMX's Debbie Kelley profile says Debbie and Pete Kelley took over Road Runner BMX in the mid-1980s and renamed it Black Mountain.

title: Road Runner ↔ Black Mountain exact chronology/site continuity
summary: The rename relationship is retrospectively supported, but exact rename year, legal continuity and site continuity remain separately controlled.

title: Window Rock and Bullhead City Kiwanis remain in the period directory record
summary: BMX Action lists Window Rock BMX and Bullhead City Kiwanis BMX in May 1985. These are later directory snapshots, not claims of uninterrupted operation.

title: Window Rock BMX Indoor is separately printed alongside Window Rock BMX
summary: BMX Action separately lists Window Rock BMX Indoor and Window Rock BMX with Jerry Pete and the same published telephone number. June repeats the Indoor identity; relationship and physical site remain open.

title: Hills ’n Spills BMX is already present in Peoria
summary: BMX Action lists Hills ’n Spills BMX with Gene Garcez; BMX Plus! repeats it in June. The separate Peoria Dunes BMX identity remains unmerged pending formal lineage/site evidence.

title: Heritage Park BMX appears under Phoenix
summary: The May 1985 BMX Action Arizona directory lists Heritage Park BMX under Phoenix with Kathy Scott. The recovered June 1985 directory does not repeat the identity. v0.44 withdraws the prior Prescott park association and leaves the exact Phoenix site open.

title: Desert Edge BMX appears in the Phoenix directory record
summary: BMX Action lists Desert Edge BMX under Phoenix with Scott Koby and telephone number 602-861-6070. The same issue separately prints Heritage Park BMX with a shared contact number; the Atlas preserves that as a relationship signal only, not a merge or site claim.

title: Bullhead BMX appears as a separate Bullhead City directory identity
summary: BMX Plus! lists Bullhead BMX with John Schneider. The published telephone number matches the May Bullhead City Kiwanis BMX listing, creating a continuity signal without authorizing a merge.

title: Winter Nationals move to Scottsdale Jaycees Rodeo BMX Park
status: B1 PERIOD VENUE + LOCAL HISTORICAL SITE NARROWING
summary: BMX Plus! identifies Scottsdale Jaycees Rodeo BMX Park as the 1986 Winter Nationals venue. A Scottsdale Historical Society record independently places the old Jaycees Rodeo Arena east of 78th Street north of Osborn Road at the Scottsdale Stadium complex, narrowing the venue while leaving the exact BMX course point open.

title: New Holbrook BMX facility begins racing at Navajo County Fairgrounds
summary: Period Holbrook reporting documents the new Navajo County Fairgrounds BMX facility entering competition in October 1989 and separately records major fill-dirt work, more than 110 truck trips and National Bike League representative Bob Tedesco engineering the construction. Exact final course geometry remains open.

title: BMXpress races at the Navajo County Fairgrounds
summary: The June 26 Tribune-News reports a June 22 race day at the BMXpress track at the county fairgrounds in Holbrook.

title: Painted Desert BMX Track opens its 1992 racing season
summary: Period reporting identifies Painted Desert BMX Track at the Navajo County Fairgrounds and records April 4 as the opening day of the 1992 racing season.

title: Local retrospective places SARA Park BMX Raceway in the early 1990s
summary: A 2017 RiverScene feature states that SARA Park BMX Raceway was built in the early 1990s and rebuilt from the ground up around 2015, with asphalt turns retained.

title: A period directory preserves a wider Arizona track network
summary: A 1998 BMX track guide lists Desert Sky, London Bridge, Parker, Coppertown, Thunder Raceway and RAM BMX in Arizona.

title: London Bridge BMX ↔ SARA Park BMX Raceway identity/site relationship
summary: London Bridge BMX and SARA Park BMX Raceway are independently documented historical identities. SARA Park’s later transition to the Lake Havasu City BMX name is separately governed. What remains unresolved is whether London Bridge and SARA Park represent the same BMX course, different organizations using one course, separate facilities, overlapping names, or another documented arrangement. No predecessor direction is assumed.

title: Kim Hayashi becomes a Chandler BMX local
summary: Kim Hayashi's official Hall of Fame profile identifies her as a Chandler BMX local beginning in 1998.

title: Tri State BMX Association nonprofit record appears in Lake Havasu City
summary: IRS-derived directory data places Tri State BMX Association Inc. in Lake Havasu City with a November 1998 exempt-status field.

title: Prescott Valley declines Mountain Valley Park BMX proposal
summary: A Town-hosted historical clipping compilation records that the council declined a BMX-track proposal for Mountain Valley Park and suggested Antelope Park or a future Agua Fria Park. This is not evidence for the 1983–1984 Mile-Hi site.

title: Colorado River BMX Inc. receives a reported May 1999 nonprofit ruling date
summary: An IRS-derived nonprofit database lists Colorado River BMX Inc. in Bullhead City with a May 1999 ruling date and Walter Thompson as the in-care-of name. This is an organizational anchor only; no 1984–1985 lineage or Highland Road site continuity is inferred.

title: Yuma County record anchors a 2001 agreement with Yuma BMX, Inc.
summary: A later Yuma County Board record explicitly references an August 20, 2001 agreement between Yuma County and Yuma BMX, Inc. and identifies a portion of Section 2, Township 9 South, Range 23 West as governed by the earlier agreement. The complete 2001 legal description and exact BMX course footprint remain unrecovered.

title: A dated directory preserves Sara Park, Parker, Coppertown and RAM
summary: Cycling Utah's March 2002 ABA track directory lists Sara Park BMX, Parker BMX, Coppertown BMX and RAM BMX in Arizona, strengthening dated chronology without proving exact sites or lineage.

title: Mile High BMX hosts Chino Valley State Qualifier
summary: USA BMX results document a State Qualifier at Mile High BMX in Chino Valley with 1020 W Palamino Rd published as the event address.

title: Historical Tucson tracks ↔ Sports Park / Tucson BMX
summary: Manzanita BMX Raceway and Desert Sunset BMX are now independently supported as distinct Tucson-area BMX facilities. Remaining lineage questions concern RAM BMX ↔ Manzanita, Manzanita ↔ later/current Tucson facilities, Desert Sunset ↔ later/current Tucson facilities, and any still-unresolved Sports Park/Tucson BMX historical relationship.

title: Manzanita hosts a Redline Cup qualifier
summary: A 2003 schedule lists Manzanita BMX Raceway as a Redline Cup qualifier host.

title: Tucson approves Desert Sunset BMX lease at Harrison Landfill
summary: The City of Tucson approved a lease with Desert Sunset BMX, Inc. for operation of a dirt bicycle track at Harrison Landfill.

title: Mile High BMX repeats as Chino Valley State Qualifier host
summary: USA BMX again lists Mile High BMX in Chino Valley for a State Qualifier and repeats the same published address.

title: Pima County documents a BMX track at Winston Reynolds–Manzanita Park
summary: Pima County’s Southwest Infrastructure Plan lists a BMX track among the park amenities and references planned improvements at the BMX track.

title: Official results preserve a Manzanita race
summary: A sanctioning-body event record preserves race results from Manzanita BMX Raceway in Tucson.

title: Old Home Manor planning record lists a BMX track
summary: A public corridor study identifies Town-owned Old Home Manor Park and includes a BMX track among the listed amenities. The generic site witness is kept separate from named Chino Valley BMX identities.

title: Manzanita and Desert Sunset independently documented as separate Tucson BMX facilities
summary: A regional transportation study and a contemporaneous Tucson cycling inventory independently treat Manzanita and Desert Sunset as separate BMX facilities; historical lineage beyond that distinctness remains open.

title: Lake Havasu City reports SARA Park sublease with Tri State BMX
summary: The City FY 2010-11 budget reports a SARA Park sublease relationship with Tri State BMX in the prior-year accomplishments period.

title: Show Low BMX track is constructed
summary: Show Low City Council minutes state that the city BMX track was originally constructed in 2010 and later hosted weekly races and sanctioned events.

title: ABA/USA BMX is publicly described as headquartered in Chandler
summary: A 2011 USA BMX article described the organization as formed in 1977 and headquartered in Chandler, Arizona.

title: Manzanita BMX Raceway hosts Corben Sharrah special race at 5200 S Westover
summary: A contemporary local events notice names Manzanita BMX Raceway at 5200 S Westover Ave for a special BMX race honoring Corben Sharrah.

title: USA BMX's media operation is still datelined Gilbert
summary: A USA BMX announcement datelined Gilbert named Jason 'Shooter' McGuire as the new editor and photographer for PULL magazine.

title: Olympic Day reaches Desert Sunset and Sara Park
summary: USA BMX listed Desert Sunset BMX for Olympic Day on June 23 and Sara Park BMX Raceway on June 27.

title: Dominique Daniels adds a collegiate national title for Grand Canyon University
summary: USA BMX championship results list Dominique Daniels first in the collegiate women's final, from Gilbert, representing Grand Canyon University.

title: USA BMX is publicly described as headquartered in Gilbert
summary: A 2014 USA BMX article described the American Bicycle Association / USA BMX as headquartered in Gilbert, Arizona.

title: Patrick Tinnell Balance Bike Track is built at Lake Havasu City BMX
summary: The official track page says the balance-bike track was built in 2015 in memory of Army Specialist Patrick A. Tinnell.

title: Lake Havasu approves Strider track development at SARA Park
summary: Lake Havasu City Parks and Recreation Advisory Board minutes record unanimous approval to develop a separate Strider track next to the regular BMX track at SARA Park.

title: City records Corey Bohan visit to Patrick Tinnell Memorial Sports Park
summary: Lake Havasu City minutes report that pro BMX rider Corey Bohan visited Patrick Tinnell Memorial Sports Park and that the visit was planned for Ride BMX coverage.

title: Tucson's Corben Sharrah becomes BMX World Champion
summary: USA Cycling identifies Corben Sharrah as a two-time Olympian and 2017 World Champion from Tucson.

title: Official racing pauses at Show Low after standards change
summary: The City said revised sanctioning standards left the track noncompliant and no official races were held after 2017.

title: Rebuilt SARA Park BMX track opens after Tri-State / SARA crew fundraising
summary: RiverScene reported the rebuilt SARA Park BMX track reopening after nearly two months of work and years of fundraising by Tri-State BMX Association and the SARA Park BMX crew.

title: Harry and Patty Leary begin operating SARA Park BMX
summary: RiverScene reported in June 2018 that Harry and Patty Leary were the new SARA Park BMX operators and had operated the track since April.

title: Colorado River BMX reopens off Highland Road
summary: A Bullhead City local-news feature reports that Colorado River BMX reopened off Highland Road in August 2018 under Turnell Henry after a closure of several years. The closure start and earlier lineage remain open.

title: Lake Havasu City BMX Association nonprofit corporation is filed
summary: ACC-derived directory data records Lake Havasu City BMX Association as an Arizona nonprofit corporation filed September 12, 2018, eight days before the separately governed municipal track-renaming ceremony.

title: SARA Park BMX is officially renamed Lake Havasu City BMX
summary: Lake Havasu City minutes record a BMX-track renaming ceremony and state that the new name would be Lake Havasu City BMX.

title: Black Mountain Winter Nationals show a statewide Arizona rider footprint
summary: USA BMX's 2019 Winter Nationals report records Arizona riders from Phoenix, Tucson, Chandler, Kingman, Gilbert, Mesa, Avondale, Surprise, Tempe and more.

title: USA BMX announces headquarters and Hall of Fame relocation from Arizona
summary: USA BMX said it was then located in Gilbert and would relocate its headquarters and Hall of Fame museum to Tulsa.

title: High Desert 66 is named in a USA BMX event description at the Mohave County Fairgrounds
summary: A USA BMX event record at 2600 Fairgrounds Blvd contains event-description text naming High Desert 66 and directing riders to the High Desert 66 BMX Facebook page. The current Interstate BMX shell label is not backdated.

title: Gold Cup Finals Southwest at Sports Park BMX
summary: USA BMX confirmed the 2020 Gold Cup Finals South West at Sports Park BMX.

title: Chandler and Black Mountain place in USA BMX Western Region Top 10
summary: USA BMX ranked Chandler BMX third and Black Mountain BMX fourth in its 2020 Western Region Top-10 track list.

title: Show Low approves reconstruction and operation agreement
summary: The Show Low City Council unanimously approved an agreement with Show Low BMX, LLC to reconstruct and operate the BMX track at Nikolaus Homestead Park.

title: Route 66 Classic Nationals at High Desert 66 BMX
summary: USA BMX moved a national weekend to High Desert 66 BMX in Kingman and identified Harry Leary as Track Operator; Kingman later reported roughly 500 competitors and 2,200–3,000 spectators at the Mohave County Fairgrounds.

title: High Desert 66 BMX ↔ Interstate BMX succession
summary: A 2017 IRS-derived filing anchors High Desert 66 BMX Inc. in Kingman, and a September 2020 USA BMX event description explicitly uses the High Desert 66 name at 2600 Fairgrounds Blvd. Current USA BMX uses Interstate BMX at that address. The exact legal/operator transition and organizational succession remain open.

title: Arizona State Final Weekend links Sports Park and Chandler
summary: The weekend began with a Sports Park State Race, then moved to Chandler for the pre-race and State Final.

title: Goodyear hosts Gold Cup Championship Southwest
summary: USA BMX results document the Gold Cup Championship Southwest at Goodyear BMX Raceway.

title: Debbie Kelley retires after decades at Black Mountain
summary: USA BMX says Debbie Kelley retired at the beginning of 2024 after running the Phoenix track since 1985 and sold the track to Bubba Harris and Karl Clark.

title: Mohave County records capital spending for Colorado River BMX
summary: Mohave County’s FY2026 tentative budget reports $48,118 in FY2024 actual capital expenditures under the Colorado River BMX ARPA line item.

title: Interstate BMX hosts Gold Cup Final Southwest
summary: USA BMX listed the 2024 Gold Cup Final Southwest at Interstate BMX in Kingman.

title: Colorado River hosts state and Gold Cup qualifiers
summary: Official USA BMX records document a State Championship Qualifier followed by a Gold Cup Qualifier at Colorado River BMX.

title: Sports Park hosts Gold Cup Qualifier
summary: USA BMX results document a Gold Cup Qualifier at Sports Park BMX.

title: Lake Havasu City BMX hosts State Race
summary: USA BMX results document a State Race at Lake Havasu City BMX.

title: Sports Park hosts 2026 State Race
summary: USA BMX results document a State Race at Sports Park BMX.

title: Yuma hosts Gold Cup and state qualifier weekend
summary: USA BMX listed a Gold Cup Qualifier followed by a State Championship Qualifier at Yuma BMX.

title: Lake Havasu hosts State + Gold Cup qualifier weekend
summary: Official USA BMX records document consecutive State Championship and Gold Cup qualifiers at Lake Havasu City BMX.

title: Colorado River hosts 2026 State Championship Qualifier
summary: USA BMX documents a State Championship Qualifier at Colorado River BMX.

title: Tucson BMX hosts Race for Life
summary: USA BMX results document a Race for Life at Tucson BMX.

title: Mingus Mountain hosts State Championship Qualifier
summary: USA BMX documents a State Championship Qualifier at Mingus Mountain BMX (Wheelhouse).

title: Show Low hosts State Championship Qualifier
summary: An official sanctioning-body result record documents a State Championship Qualifier at Show Low BMX.

title: Show Low BMX has a dated 2026 race result
summary: USA BMX published results for a local race at Show Low BMX on July 19, 2026.

title: J&M BMX appears in Tempe directory
summary: The March 1984 Bikes & Dirt Arizona directory lists J&M BMX under Tempe with Mel Allen and two published telephone numbers. Exact site, operating span and sanction history remain open.

title: National BMX directory independently lists Navajo County BMXPRESS
summary: GO: The Rider’s Manual lists Navajo County BMXPRESS in Holbrook with Paul DoBell and 602-524-6407; a separate NEW TRACKS box repeats Holbrook / BMX Press / Paul Dobell. The label is not treated as a physical opening date because local newspapers document the facility in 1989.

title: Painted Desert BMX announces qualifier weekend
summary: A 1992 Tribune-News report says Painted Desert BMX Track had been designated for an August 15–16 qualifier and that more than 150 riders were expected. This records the announcement, not proof of actual attendance or completion.
